source_audit.finding: fixed oneshot launch retains RemainAfterExit=true; terminal DTO/wait accepts inactive/failed only, so genuine active/exited retained result is denied
source_audit.evidence_limit: Root reports real ARM64 systemd named read-only OpenFile FD3 transfer. This amendment does not pin uncommitted evidence or establish native task/Pi acceptance.

launch: Existing fixed suite launcher only: Type=oneshot, RemainAfterExit=true; retain existing unit/invocation/PIDFD/cgroup/start/executable/release/journal/evidence key joins and original deadlines. No arbitrary command or unit names.

field_semantics.main_pid: original launched PID from retained controller, never replaced with zero
field_semantics.exec_main_pid: retained systemd ExecMainPID must equal original launched PID
field_semantics.exec_main_code: fresh systemd ExecMainCode integer; active/exited branch requires normal CLD_EXITED (1)
field_semantics.exec_main_status: fresh ExecMainStatus integer; active/exited branch requires 0 and equals exit_code
field_semantics.exec_main_exit_monotonic_usec: fresh positive integer microseconds from ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic; within same boot and original launch interval, not a new lease

active_exited_predicate: positive exit timestamp at/after original controller launch and not after observation
unchanged InvocationID, exact owned cgroup device/inode/path identity
owned cgroup empty recursively and retained controller PIDFD reports dead
current parent installed actor/release/journal/evidence-key custody and original deadline
fresh stable property snapshot: reread InvocationID/state/substate/main PID/exit tuple and deny drift
other_terminal_states: Existing inactive/failed branches remain literal observations with genuine recorded status/code and dead PIDFD/empty cgroup/same invocation. No failure status is promoted to success; activating/deactivating/active-running/reloading always nonterminal.

api.wait: RootInstalledQualificationSupervisor.wait_terminal(controller) -> RootQualificationControllerTerminal; controller.wait_terminal issues same sealed retained object only after predicate
api.verify: RootLaunchedQualificationController.verify_terminal_current(terminal) -> RootQualificationControllerTerminal; exact controller._terminal object, membership and fresh terminal snapshot/parent proof checks; no live-child verify_current call for a dead process
api.consume: Existing supervisor.resolve_result(controller, terminal) calls verify_terminal_current before signed result/cleanup joins; terminal success does not imply qualification passed
api.collect: Existing supervisor.collect_verified_controller(controller, terminal) requires consumed result plus verify_terminal_current; stops only exact already-quiescent purpose-owned retained unit, waits bounded for inactive/gone with empty cgroup and no live retained PIDFD, then closes key/PIDFD/journal. Foreign/restarted invocation denies; no kill fallback.

failure_cleanup: close_after_terminal_without_evidence requires exact current sealed terminal and quiescence, then same purpose-owned retained unit collection. Missing/tampered evidence remains failed/incomplete; never fabricate consumption. Unit stop cannot authorize killing foreign descendants; any nonempty cgroup or changed invocation denies collection. Preserve genuine failed evidence before reset/collection.
prohibitions: do not relabel active as inactive
no original lease extension/reset or new task authority from terminal evidence
no TTL renewal, PID reuse, missing invocation acceptance or foreign unit stop
no source pin approvals or full native acceptance from FD-transfer fixture
tests: real retained oneshot active/exited positive with named read-only FD transfer and unchanged invocation
active-running, wrong SubState, live PIDFD, nonzero MainPID, wrong ExecMainPID/code/status/timestamp deny
changed invocation or cgroup inode/descendants/property snapshot deny
signed passed/failed/incomplete result still requires original independent proof joins
consume then purpose-owned stop/collection positive; foreign invocation and pre-consumption collection deny
acceptance: All AC01..AC18 OPEN; fixture transport and controller terminal proof remain distinct from actual native qualification and Pi acceptance.
